title: Aletheia eval claim
description: One human-reviewed claim with its expected decision. The decision shape (outcome, verdict, undecided reason, Almost correction) mirrors the research decision contract; flag types and dimensions mirror README section 6. evals/validate.py reads the enums from this file, so this schema is the single source for them.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. t001. Never reused, even if the claim is dropped.

split.description: Only tuning claims live in this repository. Held-out claims are kept elsewhere.

claim.description: The claim exactly as a user would submit it.

context.description: Optional context submitted with the claim (README section 7 context fields).

case_type.description: What the claim tests, so the set covers each kind of case.

expected.description: The decision a correct investigation should reach.

acceptable_alternatives.description: Other decisions that also count as correct. May be empty; must not repeat the expected decision.

expected_flags.description: Qualification flags a correct investigation should raise. Empty means none expected.

key_sources.description: 1 to 3 sources a correct run should find, and what each shows.

as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the expected decision was checked. Evidence can change after it.

labelers.description: Who labeled this record. One name in a blind label file; two in a reconciled record.

status.description: draft: one labeler's blind label. reconciled: both labelers agree. contested: still disagree after discussion; the tie-breaker decided.

reviewer_note.description: Why this decision is expected. For contested records, also what the disagreement was.

decision.description: Decided: a verdict and no reason. Unable to decide: a reason and a null verdict. Almost, and only Almost, needs an expected correction.

expected_correction.description: Reviewed expectation for an Almost correction, so a matching label can't hide a wrong correction.

rationale.description: The specific difference, e.g. 'compares a 32-sample chain-of-thought score with a 5-shot score'.

shows.description: What this source establishes for the claim.
